messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Shop····, email (email hidden)

Nothing has changed since we spoke this afternoon, John. Shop···· is paid and hasn't shipped yet. Your Magic M. 40T is still waiting on stock at our US warehouse, and your Diagnostics + 3-Month RMA add-on is on the same order.

Magic M. expects the units to ship out from the factory on November 12, which is today. When your miner ships to you, we'll email you the tracking automatically. You don't need to keep checking here to get it.

You can follow that shipment on its way to our warehouse at https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Is there something about the order I can help with?
